audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer's phases hand Lucian levels 1-3, level 6 and two items, which contradicts the content layer's own whys (whys[4] gives Akali the level-6 execute, whys[5] the first-item one-combo) and the 52.56% Emerald+ figure.
audit.why: Both directions cannot be right on the same site. The sample is only 33 games, so I did not guess a new chart - I left every side and rating untouched and raised it as a question instead.
audit.corrected: No chart edits made; see questionsForUser.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes listed 'Relentless Pursuit online, level 6, first item' with no numbers, and the level-6 phase never named The Culling.
audit.why: The Culling is 110/100/90s - a spike you can actually track. Relentless Pursuit is 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s, and Akali's own spike is Twilight Shroud at 4-5, not levels 2-3 as breakdown.spikes claimed.
audit.corrected: breakdown.spikes and phases[4].why rebuilt on The Culling's 110s and Shroud at 4-5.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two decisive interactions were absent everywhere: Ardent Blaze reveals, and Relentless Pursuit's cooldown is shortened by Lightslinger attacks.
audit.why: Riot's text for Ardent Blaze says it marks and briefly reveals enemies hit, so it finds Akali sitting in Twilight Shroud - the page told you to shroud and stand still. And Relentless Pursuit's cooldown is reduced by Lightslinger attacks, so 'engage when it's down' by stopwatch is wrong advice; you bait it instead. Also worth stating: his Piercing Light is 500 range against your 550, so you out-range his Q.
audit.corrected: tldr, enemyWin, winCon, phases[1].why, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, report[5].t and report[11].t now carry the reveal, the cooldown reduction and the 500-vs-550 range gap.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns described Relentless Pursuit only as 'His dash + reset. Engage when it's down.'
audit.why: That is the whole punish window of the lane and it carried no number and no mention that his own attacks shorten it.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns now gives 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s, the Lightslinger reduction, and The Culling's 110/100/90s.

edits.after: He kites you out — survive, then shroud his Relentless Pursuit and burst the gap. Ardent Blaze reveals you in the smoke.

edits.after: - Lucian Relentless Pursuit: matchup-defining — 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s, but every Lightslinger attack shaves it, so bait it rather than counting seconds. - The Culling: 110/100/90s. - Your ultimate: kill windows only.

notes: The _missing file lists needs-antiheal and shield-absorbs-burst for Lucian, both keyed to Lightslinger (P). Riot's own text only says Lucian gets bonus damage when an ALLY heals or shields him — he has no self-heal and no self-shield, so both rules are tooltip-parsing misfires and I wrote no anti-heal or shield-baiting advice. Only 33 games on this matchup, so the win-rate-versus-chart conflict is weak evidence either way.
